data.long_description:
Rosemont Residences stands as a beacon of sophistication, blending distinctive architecture with a warm, family-focused community. Designed with a focus on comfort, convenience, and style, this elegant building harmoniously integrates into the serene ambiance of Jumeirah Village Triangle, offering residents a peaceful retreat to call home.

World-class amenities are provided for residents: gym, swimming pool surrounded by lush greenery and tall palm trees, children's playgrounds.

The JVT area is located at the intersection of Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, allowing residents to quickly reach key locations in Dubai. Schools, kindergartens, medical facilities, stores, cafes and restaurants are located in the area. It takes about 15 minutes to reach City Center Me'aisem, Mall of the Emirates, JBR Beach, and the famous Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden parks. Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 25 minutes away.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
